caseName: United States Fidelity & Guaranty Co. v. Travelers Insurance Machine Co.
caseNameFull: United States Fidelity & Guaranty Company v. Travelers Insurance Machine Company
summary: Appeal from the District Court of the United States for the District of Arizona.
attorneys: Mr. William Marshall Bullitt for appellant., Mr. David R. Castleman and Mr. Walter Bennett for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Bache v. Hunt, 193 U. S. 523; Louisville Trust Co. v. Knott, 191 U. S. 225; Railroad Commission of Mississippi v. Louisville & Nashville R. R. Co., 225 U. S. 272, 279.
